recommendedTextbook.title: Junior Secondary Agricultural Science for Nigerian Schools Book 3
recommendedTextbook.author: Anthony Youdeowei, S. O. Ayanlaja, C. C. Agwubike
recommendedTextbook.approvedBy: NERDC & Lagos State Ministry of Basic Education

topics.topic: Agricultural Economics: Farm Records and Accounts
subtopics: Importance of farm records to commercial farming
Types: Farm diary, inventory records, production records, labor records
Profit and loss account, farm balance sheet calculation in Naira
objectives: Explain 4 reasons for keeping accurate farm records
Prepare a simple farm inventory record table
Calculate net farm profit or loss from hypothetical enterprise data

subtopics: Viral and bacterial diseases: Newcastle, Foot and mouth, Anthrax, Coccidiosis
Prevention: Vaccination, dipping, deworming, quarantine, biosecurity footbaths
objectives: Classify livestock diseases by causal pathogen
Describe economic loss caused by Newcastle disease in poultry
Outline a farm biosecurity sanitation plan for a Nigerian poultry farm

topics.topic: Soil Fertility, Organic Manure and Chemical Fertilizers
subtopics: Meaning of soil fertility and causes of nutrient depletion
Organic manures: Farmyard manure, compost manure, green manure
Inorganic fertilizers: NPK ratios, urea, application techniques (broadcasting, placement)
objectives: Explain steps involved in preparing a compost pit
Calculate nitrogen, phosphorus, potassium percentages in NPK 15:15:15
Demonstrate safe placement application of inorganic fertilizer

topics.topic: Packaging, Processing and Export of Agricultural Produce
subtopics: Processing methods for cassava, cocoa, palm oil, and ginger
Packaging materials: Jute bags, plastic crates, glass bottles, cartons
Major Nigerian agricultural export commodities and NEPC regulations
objectives: Describe traditional and mechanized processing of cassava into garri
Identify export requirements for Nigerian cocoa beans and sesame seeds
Analyze roles of the Nigerian Export Promotion Council (NEPC)
